reason: The README describes a runtime governance bundle for coding-agent execution, centered on progress monitoring, evidence freshness, completion guards, capability routing, and Linux/WSL execution integration.

summaries.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 编码代理的运行时治理插件，用于进度监控、证据校验、完成声明约束、能力路由以及 Linux/WSL 执行集成。
summaries.en: A runtime governance plugin for DeepSeek Harness coding agents that monitors progress, validates execution evidence, constrains completion claims, routes capabilities, and integrates Linux/WSL execution.

capabilities: Governs coding-agent progress and completion decisions
Collects shell execution and sandbox fact evidence
Routes capabilities based on task profiles
Launches the DeepSeek Harness runtime through WSL
Runs native Linux and WSL diagnostic and installation checks
